business_summary: Futian Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides wastewater and drinking water treatment engineering services in Mainland China and Vietnam. It operates through six segments: EPC Projects, Equipment Projects, Service Concession Arrangement, Advertising, Property Leasing, and Others. The company engages in the design, procurement, and construction of sludge or wastewater treatment facilities; procurement of materials, equipment, and machinery, as well as installation, testing and commissioning, and provision of technical consulting services; and construction, operation, and maintenance of sludge treatment and station, as well as restoration of the infrastructure. It is also involved in processing services for advertising materials and the placement of advertisements on various media platforms; leasing of own investment properties and sub-leasing of commercial properties leased from third-party landlords to independent tenants; and operation and maintenance services for other construction projects. In addition, the company engages in online advertising and related services for online games; design, construction, and sale of equipment for environmental protection projects; and investment, operation, and project management of commercial real estate projects. Further, it is involved in sewage disposal; soil remediation; solid and hazardous waste treatment and disposal; sludge drying reduction; smoke business; and other related environmental services. The company was formerly known as China TianYF Holdings Group Limited and changed its name to Futian Holdings Limited in March 2024. Futian Holdings Limited was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
business_summary_ko: Futian Holdings Limited는 자회사와 함께 중국 본토와 베트남에서 폐수 및 식수 처리 엔지니어링 서비스를 제공합니다. EPC 프로젝트, 장비 프로젝트, 서비스 양허 계약, 광고, 부동산 임대 및 기타 등 6개 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 회사는 슬러지 또는 폐수 처리 시설의 설계, 조달 및 건설에 종사합니다. 자재, 장비, 기계 조달, 설치, 테스트, 시운전, 기술 컨설팅 서비스 제공 슬러지 처리 및 스테이션의 건설, 운영 및 유지 관리는 물론 인프라 복원도 포함됩니다. 또한 광고 자료 처리 서비스와 다양한 미디어 플랫폼에 광고 게재에도 참여하고 있습니다. 자체 투자 부동산 임대 및 제3자 임대인이 독립 임차인에게 임대한 상업용 부동산 재임대; 기타 건설 프로젝트에 대한 운영 및 유지보수 서비스. 또한 회사는 온라인 게임에 대한 온라인 광고 및 관련 서비스에 종사합니다. 환경보호사업 장비 설계, 시공, 판매
